steps.title: Open BRELA ORS Portal
steps.instruction: Go to ors.brela.go.tz in your browser to access the Online Registration System
steps.instruction_sw: Nenda kwenye ors.brela.go.tz katika kivinjari chako kupata Mfumo wa Usajili wa Mtandaoni

steps.title: Create Account or Login
steps.instruction: If you are new, click 'Register' to create an account. If you already have an account, click 'Login'
steps.instruction_sw: Ikiwa wewe ni mpya, bonyeza 'Jisajili' kuunda akaunti. Ikiwa tayari una akaunti, bonyeza 'Ingia'
steps.expected_screen: BRELA ORS homepage with Register and Login buttons
steps.success_indicator: Logged in to BRELA ORS dashboard

steps.title: Start New Business Registration
steps.instruction: On the dashboard, click 'New Registration' then select 'Business Name' for a sole trader or 'Company' for a limited company
steps.instruction_sw: Kwenye dashibodi, bonyeza 'Usajili Mpya' kisha chagua 'Jina la Biashara' kwa mfanyabiashara mmoja au 'Kampuni' kwa kampuni ndogo

steps.title: Search Business Name Availability
steps.title_sw: Tafuta Upatikanaji wa Jina la Biashara
steps.instruction: Enter your proposed business name and click 'Search' to check if the name is available
steps.instruction_sw: Weka jina unalokusudia la biashara yako na bonyeza 'Tafuta' kuangalia kama jina linapatikana
steps.success_indicator: Search results showing name availability status

steps.title: Fill Registration Form
steps.instruction: Fill in all required fields: business owners/directors, address, nature of business, and share capital if applicable
steps.instruction_sw: Jaza sehemu zote zinazohitajika: wamiliki/wakurugenzi wa biashara, anwani, asili ya biashara, na mtaji wa hisa ikiwa inatumika
steps.expected_screen: Business registration form with multiple sections
steps.success_indicator: All required fields filled, form ready to submit

steps.title: Pay Registration Fee
steps.instruction: Review the registration fee shown, then click 'Pay Now' and complete payment via mobile money or bank transfer
steps.instruction_sw: Kagua ada ya usajili iliyoonyeshwa, kisha bonyeza 'Lipa Sasa' na ukamilishe malipo kupitia pesa za simu au uhamisho wa benki
steps.expected_screen: Payment page with fee amount and payment options

steps.title: Submit and Download Certificate
steps.instruction: After payment, click 'Submit Application'. Your registration certificate will be emailed and available to download from your dashboard
steps.instruction_sw: Baada ya malipo, bonyeza 'Tuma Maombi'. Cheti chako cha usajili kitatumwa kwa barua pepe na kitapatikana kupakuliwa kutoka kwenye dashibodi yako
steps.expected_screen: Payment confirmation page with Submit Application button
steps.success_indicator: Application submitted with reference number shown
